baseline.limitation: Privacy-filtered Search Analytics top rows; missing query/page/market/device rows are UNKNOWN, not zero.

checkpoints.label: T+0
checkpoints.purpose: Bind exact published variant, public API readback, rendered title/H1/canonical, CTA routes, indexability hold, and analytics contract.

checkpoints.label: T+3
checkpoints.purpose: Safety and instrumentation only; confirm analytics continuity, mobile rendering, CTA/form routing, and failure guardrails.

checkpoints.label: T+7
checkpoints.purpose: Directional query-owner and funnel check; no expansion conclusion.

checkpoints.label: T+14
checkpoints.purpose: Interim search/funnel assessment by market and device; hold when evidence is insufficient or confounded.

checkpoints.label: T+28
checkpoints.purpose: Compare with the frozen 28-day pre-period and decide keep, revise, rollback, or insufficient data.

decision_boundary: No EXPAND or STOP verdict before a complete comparable T+28 window; insufficient data is valid.
